sourceLabel: Audited results filed with NSE and BSE, 8 May 2026
definition: Profit for the year after all expenses and tax. It is not operating profit or cash flow.
location: Filing PDF page 12 (consolidated results, year ended 31-Mar-26 column) and PDF page 15 (consolidated segment table and notes); no printed page numbers. Headline figures cross-checked to the company press release, PDF page 2
notes: Source figures are in ₹ million and were divided by 10. Revenue is total revenue from operations, which includes other operating revenue of ₹1,372.17 crore, and excludes other income of ₹949.04 crore. Profit is after tax of ₹1,811.54 crore (profit before tax ₹7,243.06 crore). Hyundai reports one operating segment (making and selling vehicles, engines and parts, with related after-sales, engineering and broking services), so its segment profit is the same ₹7,243.06 crore and it does not disclose profit by model or by domestic versus export sales. Two notes matter for profit: the cost of the new Labour Codes (wage and labour rules) is included in employee costs but the amount is not stated, and no provision is made for new end-of-life vehicle scrapping rules, because the company says the cost cannot yet be estimated.
insight: Hyundai reports its car-making business as one segment, so these totals cannot show profit by model or between domestic and export sales. Its profit in a year can move with costs it has not yet been able to measure.
